Asylum - Release Date Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019427

The doors of Hanwell Mental Institute are opening once again…

ASYLUM, the psychological horror adventure from the creators of Scratches and Serena, is coming to consoles on October 30, 2026.

Step into the mind of a former patient plagued by bizarre and disturbing visions. Explore the decaying halls of Hanwell Mental Institute, investigate its dark history, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the horrors hidden within its walls.

Every corridor holds a secret. Every vision brings you closer to the truth.

But some truths were never meant to be uncovered.
